causal_reference.use: Previously completed W8 arm with equal declared PPO budget and initial policy; explicitly shared development reference

prospective_extension.comparability: Exact same environment seed, profile lane, horizon, frozen competent PID, hover thrust, nominal vehicle, measured74D encoder, adapter math and v2.1 receive-index runtime as the source control campaign
prospective_extension.training_integrity: Completed2097152 PPO timesteps, selected checkpoint1048576,16384 actual actor/prior-KL optimizer steps; selection stays fixed before this probe
prospective_extension.gates: All existing v2.1 operational gates remain fixed and are evaluated against the named shared controls. Reusing earlier development controls does not make them new independent observations. No force-mild or original six-wind-cell macro coverage is inferred
prospective_extension.error_rule: Complete all six fixed cases. Retain valid controller FAILs. Infrastructure ERROR stops unstarted cases and seals raw evidence before a separately reviewed exact replacement; no automatic retries
prospective_extension.limitations: One development environment and one training initialization. The control reuse is declared before the new candidate outcomes, but is shared development evidence. It is not fresh20-flight confirmation or three-seed validation

fixed_quality_contract.scope: Joint wind-hover and fast-waypoint-route quality on the nominal simulated Iris; not an all-fault controller claim
fixed_quality_contract.backend_for_applicability_claims: Gazebo Iris + ArduCopter4.7.2; AHRS10; raw independent world/actuator identity audit

frozen_pid_profile.rule: Same frozen competent PID for every method; never weaken or select PID using the final confirmation

task.yaw: Hold the common initial reference; this is not commanded90deg yaw tracking
task.controller_inputs: Measured position/velocity/orientation/body rates, current goal and own measured/action history only
task.no_privileged_preview: No future waypoint, true force, mass, motor effectiveness, future disturbance or physics state enters the actor
task.force: Shared protocol force_strong/gust: horizontal3N +/-10%, seeded direction and +/-0.24s event jitter; no conversion to m/s
task.same_flight: Native takeoff/landing shared; controller evaluated only during the common measurement window

five_thesis_metrics.position: Original time-weighted goal-distance RMSE and full-horizon4m-tail penalized RMSE; never call this cross-track
five_thesis_metrics.height: Original maximum downward error relative to active target. Route commanded height steps are not an uncommanded physical drop; show pre-force-relative auxiliary height separately
five_thesis_metrics.recovery: Hover only, actual independently verified final force OFF; 0.25m band held1s. Already inside at OFF is not millisecond aerodynamic adaptation
five_thesis_metrics.stability: Keep every valid controller failure, survived/full-flight heading eligibility, raw duration and censored cases
five_thesis_metrics.route_time: Completion from measurement t=0 after all five ordered0.5s dwell confirmations; unfinished routes use restricted time40s, not0 or missing-only means

geometry.source: Controller-visible AHRS10 telemetry, independently associated with physical Gazebo world; this is measured geometry, not an actor input
geometry.active_leg: For active goal j=1..4, finite segment points[j-1] to points[j]; infer pre-update goal index from ordered confirmed events, so Fast post-update goal_index cannot silently select the next leg
geometry.primary: Time-weighted 3D finite-active-segment distance RMSE over transit from confirmed goal0 to confirmed goal4. Final stationary hover is excluded
geometry.projection: For endpoints a,b and sample p, q=((p-a) dot (b-a))/||b-a||^2; finite segment uses min(1,max(0,q)), infinite line uses unclamped q. A degenerate leg is a point. No minimum/maximum error clipping or winsorizing is applied
geometry.secondary: XY infinite-line cross-track RMSE, 3D infinite-line cross-track RMSE, XY finite-segment RMSE, 3D finite-segment peak, and incoming 3D overshoot are reported separately. A commanded vertical route step contributes to 3D geometry; it is not labelled an uncommanded physical drop
geometry.corners: All three interior corners; peak distance to finite outgoing segment in closed[transition,transition+1s], plus time-weighted outgoing deviation. Exactly the existing turns_corners.py definition
geometry.censoring: A missing/unreached corner or incomplete transit is retained with coverage counts and null primary comparison, never silently dropped or assigned zero
geometry.phase_warning: Force schedule remains absolute measurement time. Faster routes can put corners in different force phases; report exposure/phase and do not describe this as a matched event-aligned wind-at-corner experiment

joint_operational_quality_gate.mild_hover_interpretation: Included in the original six-cell macro, full-flight/heading guards and cell table; no extra per-cell15%requirement is silently added to the original macro criterion
joint_operational_quality_gate.interpretation: All gates are conjunctions; accuracy cannot compensate slower/uncompleted routes or unsafe heading. These operational tolerances are new fixed engineering requirements, not values copied from the thesis literature

original_thesis_wind_macro.mandatory_final_coverage: All original six wind cells are required in the final eight-condition matrix; coverage is not evidence of passing the15%numeric criterion
original_thesis_wind_macro.coverage_rule: Nominal cannot substitute for force_mild. Add force_mild hover/route before claiming the original macro15%criterion; otherwise keep NOT_COVERED
original_thesis_wind_macro.keep_separate: A passed joint operational gate or wind-hover retention is not automatically a passed original thesis wind macro

pilot.matched_wind_reference: Existing validated wind-specialist111 on force_strong hover and gust hover only

stage_B.run_when: StageA complete and joint operational quality gate passes; otherwise retain all StageA results and revise the next version on development only

pilot.rule: Run the entire fixed stage matrix; never stop or repeat only an inconvenient controller result

mandatory_original_macro_extension.rule: A final evaluation without mild hover/route is incomplete, and a failed original15%criterion must remain failed

optional_new_causal_BC_ablation.interpretation: Without these matched BC controls, do not infer a fresh causal PPO-vs-BC gain from this final joint matrix

aggregation_and_table.row: One backend x exact policy version x scenario x mission; show absolute metrics, denominators and coverage
aggregation_and_table.weighting: Average all declared trained models within each environment, then equal-weight environments. Shared PID is one flight per environment, never tripled as independent data
aggregation_and_table.uncertainty: Environment/training-seed resampling preserves shared PID pairing; time samples are not independent replicates. With3environment seeds, report ranges and exploratory intervals honestly
aggregation_and_table.route_geometry: If any required geometry/corner window is incomplete, the primary geometry guard is not evaluable and quality cannot be green; show the missing denominator
aggregation_and_table.no_model_family_mix: Fast proxy and Gazebo are separate tables. Old wind-specialist/general-policy results never fill untested cells of the joint model

boundaries.Fast_boundary_grid: Keep all11 original scenarios x hover/route development evidence separately; valid failures stay visible. Survival there never substitutes for missing Gazebo coverage
boundaries.retry: Keep every valid controller failure and its penalized metrics. Only independently established infrastructure/recording faults may be archived and exactly repeated with a sealed reason; no successful-only comparison
